design.intent: 帮我写一个pico空间版的 Interactive 3D Solar System：A glowing sun in the center with 4 or 5 stylized planets orbiting around it at different speeds. Users can click on a planet to focus the camera on it, popping up a sleek UI card with quick facts about that planet.

warnings: Real-device comfort, occlusion, physical scale, and 3D camera behavior were not validated; the Web preview validates logic and layout only.
The solar-system scene is a stylized approximation of the final Stage scene; verify orbit radii, camera focus, raycast hit targets, and the anchored card placement on a PICO device.
Planet facts are stylized educational copy; review factual accuracy before presenting the app as a formal astronomy reference.
